newsitem.title: USA: State legislator seeks to prevent Idaho Power sale.
newsitem.headline: State legislator seeks to prevent Idaho Power sale.

text.p: A preliminary draft of an electricity restructuring bill has emerged at Idaho's Legislature which would prempt any bid to take over Idaho Power Co, a spokesman for the utility said Wednesday.
The proposal would include authorization for the state to take control of the utility if a hostile buyer emerged, said Larry Spencer, director of investor relations at Idaho Power.

He noted that Idaho Power has not been approached as a takeover target, but other regional deals -- such as the failed merger of Washington Water Power Co and Sierra Pacific Resources and the proposed merger of Enron Corp and Portland General Corp -- have raised concerns about retaining the state's hydropower resources.
The Idaho utility does not favor the preliminary legislation, preferring instead to continue "a collaborative process" taking into account the priorities of all constituencies, Spencer said.

In addition to the anti-takeover measures, the draft bill being talked about would segregate pricing for different customer classes, potentially pitting rural against urban customers and industrial against retails customers, he noted.
